environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). The NLB forwards TCP traffic directly to port 8080. No application-layer inspection is performed. TLS is terminated at the application. The instance runs in a public subnet with security group allowing inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. HMAC_SECRET environment variable is set to a proper random value. SQLite database contains production user records including admin accounts with api_key values.
